# A toy tugboat: a maroon hull, a cream cabin, a rust funnel with a dark band, a tan deck.
new
material new Hull --base-color 0.4745 0.2667 0.2902 --no-slot
material new Deck --base-color 0.8196 0.6941 0.5294 --no-slot
material new Cabin --base-color 0.8235 0.7882 0.6471 --no-slot
material new Funnel --base-color 0.6824 0.3647 0.2510 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 0.2941 0.2392 0.2667 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Hull --size 1 --location 0 0 0.06
scale 0.7 1.3 0.4
apply --scale
material assign Hull
active Hull
mode edit
select vert where "pos.y < -0.5"
scale 0.45 1 1
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Deck
mode object
add mesh cube --name Cabin --size 1 --location 0 0.12 0.46
scale 0.5 0.6 0.4
apply --scale
material assign Cabin
add mesh cylinder --name Funnel --vertices 6 --radius 0.13 --depth 0.42 --location 0 0.3 0.85
material assign Funnel
add mesh cylinder --name Band --vertices 6 --radius 0.14 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0.3 1.1
material assign Band
select all
shade flat
export tugboat.glb
